title: Large File Transfer Free – Send Up to 10GB Online
meta: Large file transfer free up to 10GB and beyond. Send big files directly, peer-to-peer, with no sign-up, no upload wait and no hassle—fast, secure and free.
h1: Transfer Files for Free Up to 10GB
h2: Free Large File Transfer – Fast, Secure & Peer-to-Peer Sharing for 10GB Files

featureHighlights.title: Direct File Transfer
description: Share your 10GB file directly from one device to another without involving any server, just by copy-pasting a link or QR code.

featureHighlights.title: No File Size Limit
description: There is no file size limit, so you can go beyond 10GB. We don’t upload your files to any server, so there is no storage cap.

featureHighlights.title: Data Security
description: Ensure 100% security and privacy for your data during online file transfers with our tool, as we don’t upload your file to a server for transfer.

featureHighlights.title: User-Friendly
description: Our file transfer web tool is easy to use, allowing you to send large files in just a few steps—without any complexity.

featureHighlights.title: Free to use
description: No charges for transferring large files between devices. You can easily share huge files without requiring sign-up or registration.

featureHighlights.title: Cross-Platform
description: Files can be shared between different operating systems and devices, such as Windows, macOS, and iOS.

howTo.heading: How can I transfer a 10GB file for free, directly and securely, from one device to another?
steps: Choose your 10GB file from your device by clicking the Add file button.
As soon as you add the file, a unique URL link and QR code are displayed on your screen. There is no upload wait.
Send this URL link or scan code to the other device to transfer the file securely and directly.

faqs.question: Is it possible for my data to be shared with a third party while transferring?
faqs.answer: No, it is impossible for your data to be shared with a third party while transferring because we don’t upload your large files to the server.

faqs.question: How can I receive a 10GB file even if my device doesn’t have enough storage?
faqs.answer: You can receive large files directly from anywhere by copying and pasting the link or scanning the code generated for the files using FileDropShare.

faqs.question: How can I send and receive 10GB files (videos, music, docs, etc.) without uploading them?
faqs.answer: You can send and receive 10GB files using peer-to-peer file-sharing technology without uploading them to a server by using our FileDropShare.

faqs.question: Can I send a 10GB file and share it with a link for free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add the file, copy the generated link or QR code and share it. The 10GB download starts directly from your device, with no registration and no cost.

faqs.question: Is large file transfer really free up to 10GB?
faqs.answer: Yes. FileDropShare is free and needs no account. Because your file is sent directly to the receiver instead of being stored on a server, there is no paid tier and no 10GB cap to unlock.

faqs.question: How long does it take to transfer a 10GB file?
faqs.answer: It depends on your internet speed. The receiver starts downloading right away, with no separate upload step first. On a fast, stable connection a 10GB file usually takes much less time than uploading it to the cloud and downloading it again.
